text: The product rule requires taking the derivative of the first factor times the second factor plus the first factor times the derivative of the second factor. Multiplying the two derivatives together does not follow this rule, and the rule point and the result point are both lost. The correct response combines 4x^3 times ln(x) with x^4 times 1/x, then simplifies the second term to get 4x^3 ln(x) + x^3.
